resolved.title: 变量赋值

content.text:
变量可以在声明时为其赋值，或在声明后再赋值。也可以根据所需改变变量的值。

**如下例子：**
content.text_html:
You have the option to assign a value to the variable at the time you declare the variable or to declare it and assign a value later. You can also change the value of a variable. Some examples:

你可以选择在声明变量时为其赋值，或在声明后再赋值。 你也可以改变变量的值。 一些例子：

content.text: 我们在声明变量`a`的时候，并没有对`a`进行赋值，但是我们对变量`b`进行了赋值操作。然后在需要使用的时候，又对`a`进行了赋值操作，并且修改了变量`b`的值。
注意，仅能对已声明的变量进行赋值。
content.text_html:
You can assign a value to a variable only in a declared data type.

你只能在已声明的数据类型中为一个变量赋值。

resolved.title: 用户输入
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]User Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To enable the user to input a value, use [b]cin [/b]in combination with the extraction operator ([b]>>[/b]). The variable containing the extracted data follows the operator.
The following example shows how to accept user input and store it in the [b]num [/b]variable: [code format="cpp" ]int num;
[b]cin >> num;[/b][/code]
[note]As with [b]cout[/b], extractions on [b]cin [/b]can be chained to request more than one input in a single statement: cin >> a >> b;[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]User Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To enable the user to input a value, use [b]cin [/b]in combination with the extraction operator ([b]>>[/b]). The variable containing the extracted data follows the operator.
The following example shows how to accept user input and store it in the [b]num [/b]variable: [code format="cpp" ]int num;
[b]cin >> num;[/b][/code]
[note]As with [b]cout[/b], extractions on [b]cin [/b]can be chained to request more than one input in a single statement: cin >> a >> b;[/note]

合。并将存储输入数据的变量跟在运算符`>>`后面。

content.text: 与**cout**一样，在**cin**上的提取可以被链起来，以便在一条语句中同时处理多个的输入，如：`cin >> a >> b`。

As with cout, extractions on **cin **can be chained to request more than one input in a single statement: cin >> a >> b;

resolved.problem_statement_md:
编写一个程序，输入两个数字。

将输入的数值赋值给变量**a**和**b**，然后输出它们的总和。

[s0l0!-header][h1]User input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Write a program that takes two numbers as input, assigns those values to the provided [b]a[/b] and [b]b[/b] variables, then outputs their [b]sum[/b].

[note]Use [b]cin[/b] for user input.[/note]
